The '''''Auxilia''-class pursuit destroyer''' was a class of [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyer]] manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] and used by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Trade Defense Force]] to supplement its [[Warship/Legends|warships]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Auxilia''-class pursuit destroyers were mentioned in [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]'s ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', published in [[2012]].<ref name="TEGtW" /> In [[Wikipedia:Latin|Latin]], the word "auxilia" refers to [[Wikipedia:Auxilia|auxiliary troops]].<ref name="A Latin Dictionary">{{WebCite|url=http://www.perseus.tufts.edu/hopper/text?doc=Perseus:text:1999.04.0059:entry=auxilium|text=auxilium|author=[[Wikipedia:Charlton Thomas Lewis|Charlton T. Lewis]], [[Wikipedia:Charles Short|Charles Short]]|work=[[Wikipedia:A Latin Dictionary|''A Latin Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20151126173308}}</ref>
